title: Olive and the Sun Pot
checkpoint: Reception Autumn 2, week 4 — Learning — Phase 2: new sounds j, v, w
note_for_grown_ups: This is the first book to use the tricky words 'the' and 'to' — point out that these two cannot be sounded out letter by letter and are learned as whole words.

pages.text: Moss got a pot. Moss put it in the sun.
pages.illustration: Moss the hedgehog setting a small plant pot down in a bright sunny spot in the greenhouse.

pages.text: Olive got a pot. Olive put it in a gap.
pages.illustration: Olive the owl copying Moss, setting her own plant pot down in a shady gap between shelves.

pages.text: The pot in the gap did not get sun.
pages.illustration: Olive's plant pot sitting in the dim, shady gap, no sunlight reaching it.
Olive the owl looking at her pot in the shady gap, drooping and unhappy.

pages.text: Olive got the pot. Olive put it in the sun.
pages.illustration: Olive the owl carrying her pot out of the shady gap and setting it down next to Moss's pot in the sun.
Olive's plant in the pot now perked up and healthy, sitting bright in the sunny spot.

pages.text: Olive and Moss sat in the sun.
pages.illustration: Olive the owl and Moss the hedgehog sitting side by side in the sunny spot, both pots thriving beside them.
